work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCXX to Bishop Franciscus of Bruges delegates to him the grant of indulgences to the members of the work of St Francis Regis, which brings poor cohabiting couples to sacramental marriage; address, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF55961–55961; the source dating clause at LF56049–56052 reads: Datum Romae apud s, Petrum die vigesima Octava maii millesimo octingentesimo quadra- gesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
